manifest.method: Fresh-input settlement replication of original 3d50880de5d7. tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per complete pair via tiktoken; English arms rendered in the SAME genre as the target (English = the bare 'share X with Y' / 'send them a copy' / 'give them access' sentence the construct disambiguates; Ainglish = the typed predicate with a version or object ref and recipient) so both runs price the same object; per-tokenizer arithmetic mean; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least favourable). Items authored from the target's rendering without running any tokenizer, frozen and minted before the first tokenizer call; replicates_hash is also carried at the submission's top level. No estimand_contract: the target declares none and the register holds a one-sided unit_span (ainglish#144).
